extras.verified_at_basis: checked against the live service on 2026-11-10
extras.quota_verbatim: 400 MB per week, reset Sunday 19:00 CET: 'Upload up to 400 MB of music each week for free' and 'Your weekly upload quota of 400 MB is automatically reset every Sunday at 7:00 pm (CET)'. ~1.7 GB/month recurring, uncapped total accumulation.
extras.limits_verbatim: 400 MB/week on Free; transcode to a single house format — 'We convert all uploaded tracks to a unified streaming format: 192 kbit/s, constant bitrate (CBR), joint stereo'; Premium can pick bitrate and gets 'original (mp3 only)' play quality.
extras.egress_verbatim: Free streaming; no per-GB egress charge. 'Podcast and RSS Feed for your Profile and Sets of music' is included on the free side, which is unusual.
extras.chaining_verbatim: 400 MB/week x N accounts, accumulating indefinitely (the quota resets, storage does not expire). ~1.7 GB/month/account at zero cost, so 10 accounts is ~17 GB/month and 100 accounts ~170 GB/month. Throughput, not quota, is the constraint.
extras.tooling_verbatim: No API. Web upload plus a 'Sounds import from sharehosters' feature (pull from a sharehoster URL rather than uploading through the browser) — that is the automation-adjacent path.
extras.agent_focus: Audio and podcast hosting where per-episode caps are large and hosts accept arbitrary files disguised as audio. Crux: does the RSS enclosure serve the ORIGINAL uploaded bytes from a permanent URL, or a re-encoded house stream?

binding_note: no constraint in the record binds at this scale; the record carries no limit of a kind the vocabulary names
